title: Junta polynomial sample sequence
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. Given a batch of restricted examples indexed by the restricted sample count, the polynomial sample sequence has length equal to the junta polynomial sample count. Its entries are the reindexed restriction examples selected from the batch by the prescribed polynomial sample indices.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
The failure parameter is rational and lies in $(0,1/2]$
The batch is a function on the indices up to the restricted sample count, with each value an assignment on coordinates outside $P$ paired with a sign
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the reindexing map or polynomial sample-index function, so their exact selection rule cannot be stated.
